extracted.name: Easy Strawberry Lemonade
extracted.description: This easy, three-ingredient strawberry lemonade recipe is made with lemonade concentrate, water, and frozen strawberries for a quick, refreshing drink.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (10 ounce) package frozen strawberries, partially thawed
instruction_lines: Combine water and lemonade concentrate in a large pitcher; stir in strawberries.
